verdict.rationale: Angular is itself a first-party development platform. Its docs describe official first-party modules for forms, routing and more, plus a broad suite of tools, APIs and libraries, installable as official packages such as @angular/cli. That is a documented official base to build against, but nothing shows SDKs in the usual sense of packaged client libraries per language or AI-oriented SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK offerings (e.g. per-language or AI-integration SDKs), SDK reference documentation, and independent corroboration of building against them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
